dict.string: Meetily Live needs the microphone to record your side of the meeting.
Meetily Live needs screen and system audio recording permission to transcribe the other participants. It does not hide itself from screen sharing.
Meetily Live needs system audio so the other participants can be transcribed separately from the microphone.
Meetily Live reads the title, notes and attendees of the next meeting on this Mac to prefill the meeting context. It does not hide itself from screen sharing.
Meetily Live can export follow-up tasks. Opening them in Reminders is optional and nothing is sent automatically.
